name: Étain, lover of Eochaid

attributes.attribute: born to the brother of Eochaid Fedlech

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: In the old Irish records, Etain marks the name of a beloved woman. She was the daughter of King Etar and the beloved of King Eochaid Fedlech. A child called Etain Og was born to the brother of Eochaid Fedlech. That brother shared his name and was called Eochaid Airem. The habit of reusing the same name is common in the books of old Ireland.

okr.objective: the Etain recorded with King Eochaid
key_results: Etain was recorded as the beloved of Eochaid Fedlech.
Her child bore the name Etain Og.
Two kings in the record reused the name Eochaid.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
